verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਚਿਰੁਜੀਵਣੇ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: jatee satee chirujeevane saadhik sidh naath gur chele|

en.bdb: Celebates, ascetics, immortal anchorites, the siddhs, naths and teacher- taughts were available in abundance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਰਿਖੀਸੁਰਾ ਭੈਰਉ ਖੇਤ੍ਰਪਾਲਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev rikheesuraa bhairau khetrapaal bahu mele|

en.bdb: Many varieties of gods, goddesses, munis, bhairavs and other protectors were there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਅਪਸਰਾ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਜੱਖ ਚਲਿਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਖੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: gan ga(n)dharab apasaraa ki(n)nar ja'kh chalit bahu khele|

en.bdb: In the name of ganas, gandharvs, fairies, kinnars and yaksas, many dragnets and dramas were enacted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਕਸਿ ਦਾਨੋ ਦੈਤ ਲਖਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: raakas dhaano dhait lakh a(n)dhar dhoojaa bhaau dhuhele|

en.bdb: Seeing raksasas, demons, deities in their imagination, people were totally in the clutches of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਕੋ ਡੁਬੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਣੇ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: haumai a(n)dhar sabh ko ddube guroo sane bahu chele|

en.bdb: All were engrossed with ego and the taughts were getting drowned alongwith their teachers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਢੂੰਡੇ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਤ੍ਰੀ ਮੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh koi na dhisiee ddoo(n)dde teerath jaatree mele|

en.bdb: Even after minute research, the guru-oriented were nowhere to be found.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕਿ ਸਭਿ ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕੰਬਰਿ ਕਉਮਿ ਕਤੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ddiThe hi(n)dhoo turak sabh peer paika(n)bar kaum katele|

en.bdb: All the sects, pirs, paigambars of the Hindus and Muslims were seen (by Baba Nanak).
Blinds were pushing the blinds into well.
